visual_description: A single portion of Chicken Shoyu Noodle Soup is presented in a deep, matte black ceramic ramen bowl. The clear, amber-hued broth serves as the base. Neatly arranged ramen noodles are submerged, topped with tender, thinly sliced chicken pieces. Two halves of a soft-boiled egg, revealing a vibrant golden, slightly runny yolk, are carefully placed on the side. The soup is garnished with a generous scattering of bright green scallion rounds and a delicate drizzle of sesame oil, creating a subtle sheen. The composition is balanced and inviting, with moderate negative space. The bowl sits on a simple, light-colored wooden table, accompanied by a pair of elegant wooden chopsticks and a large white ceramic soup spoon. A simple folded white cotton napkin rests beside the bowl. Natural, even lighting highlights the textures and colors of the dish, set against a blurred, casual bistro background.
cultural_serving_suggestions: Serve with a small side dish of shichimi togarashi (Japanese seven-spice blend) for diners to add heat.
Offer a small dish of finely sliced pickled ginger as an optional palate cleanser.
Serve hot, allowing diners to slurp noodles and broth directly from the bowl.
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add chicken breast. Cook for 15-20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 75°C. Remove chicken. Let cool slightly. Shred or thinly slice chicken. Set aside.

In a separate pot, bring water to a rolling boil for eggs. Gently lower eggs into boiling water. Cook for 6-7 minutes for soft-boiled. Immediately transfer to an ice bath. Peel eggs carefully. Halve each egg lengthwise.
In a large pot, combine chicken broth, minced garlic, and sliced ginger. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain the broth to remove garlic and ginger. Return clear broth to the pot.
Stir in soy sauce and mirin. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed. Keep warm.
Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions in a separate pot of boiling water. Drain well.
Divide cooked noodles evenly among 3 deep soup bowls.
Arrange shredded or sliced chicken over the noodles in each bowl.
Carefully ladle hot broth over noodles and chicken.
Place two egg halves on top of the chicken and noodles in each bowl.
Drizzle each bowl with sesame oil. Garnish generously with sliced green onions. Serve immediately.
notes: Achieving the perfect soft-boiled egg is key to this dish. Adjust cooking time based on egg size and desired yolk consistency.
The broth can be prepared in advance for quicker assembly.
For richer flavor, use chicken thighs instead of breast.

visual_description: A single generous portion of Homely Chicken & Egg Ramen is presented in a deep, wide ceramic bowl, evoking a sense of warmth and comfort. The golden-brown, subtly creamy broth forms the inviting base, with a hearty tangle of cooked ramen noodles submerged. Tender, irregular chunks of shredded chicken are scattered generously over the noodles. Bright orange, thinly sliced carrot rounds are interspersed, adding a pop of color and gentle crunch. One perfectly soft-boiled egg, halved lengthwise, rests prominently on the noodles, its vibrant yellow yolk peeking out. A small, rustic dollop of Dijon mustard is placed on the bowl's rim, ready to be mixed in. The dish is finished with a sprinkle of thinly sliced green onions, adding a fresh, verdant touch. It sits on a well-worn wooden kitchen table, bathed in warm, inviting light. Simple, everyday chopsticks rest casually alongside the bowl, completing the homely, authentic scene.
instructions: Prepare Chicken: Place chicken fillet in a saucepan. Cover with water. Bring to a simmer. Cook 15-20 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 75°C. Remove chicken. Shred into irregular chunks using two forks. Set aside.

Cook Eggs: While chicken cooks, bring a separate small pot of water to a boil. Gently lower eggs into boiling water. Cook 6-7 minutes for soft-boiled. Transfer to an ice bath. Peel carefully. Halve lengthwise.

Make Broth: In a large pot, heat sesame oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and grated ginger. Sauté 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in chicken broth and soy sauce. Bring to a simmer. Whisk in mayonnaise until fully combined and broth is slightly creamy. Add thinly sliced carrot rounds. Simmer 5-7 minutes until carrots are tender-crisp.
Cook Noodles: In a separate pot, cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Drain well.
Assemble Soup: Divide cooked noodles among 3 deep ceramic bowls. Ladle hot broth and carrots over noodles. Arrange shredded chicken chunks on top. Place 2 egg halves per bowl.
Garnish and Serve: Sprinkle generously with thinly sliced green onions. Add a small dollop of Dijon mustard to the side of the bowl if desired. Serve immediately.
notes: Ensure chicken reaches an internal temperature of 75°C (167°F) for food safety.

visual_description: A single modest portion of the stir-fry is served in a deep, rustic ceramic bowl. The noodles are loosely piled, intertwined with golden-brown chicken chunks, vibrant orange julienned carrots, and soft yellow scrambled egg pieces. A scattering of bright green chopped spring onions adds a pop of color on top. The components are naturally mixed and slightly overlapping, reflecting a comforting, home-style meal. No strict arrangement, just a generous scoop. The bowl rests on a well-used, slightly worn light wooden dining table. Beside the bowl, a pair of simple wooden chopsticks are casually placed on a small, plain ceramic rest. A folded, light-colored cloth napkin is tucked under the bowl. The background is softly blurred, showing hints of a warm, inviting kitchen environment. Warm, soft, natural light illuminates the dish from the side, enhancing the textures and creating subtle shadows. Chicken is cut into bite-sized chunks. Carrots are julienned into thin strips. Eggs are scrambled into soft, irregular pieces.
cultural_serving_suggestions: Serve with a side of pickled ginger.
Offer a small bowl of chili oil for those who prefer extra heat.
instructions: Prepare ingredients: Cut chicken into 2cm chunks. Julienne carrot into thin strips. Mince garlic. Grate ginger.
Cook ramen: Boil 1.5 litres of water in a pot. Add ramen noodles. Cook for 3 minutes until al dente. Drain well.

Cook chicken: Heat 15ml vegetable oil in a large wok or pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken chunks. Sear for 5-7 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 75°C. Remove chicken from pan. Set aside.
Cook eggs: Add remaining 5ml oil to the same pan. Beat eggs in a small bowl. Pour in beaten eggs. Scramble until just set. Remove eggs from pan. Set aside.

Stir-fry vegetables: Add remaining 10ml vegetable oil to the pan. Add minced garlic and grated ginger. Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add julienned carrot. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Make sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mayonnaise, and mustard.
Combine: Return cooked ramen, chicken, and scrambled egg to the pan with carrots. Pour in the sauce. Toss well to coat all ingredients evenly.
Finish: Stir-fry briefly for 1 minute until heated through. Drizzle with sesame oil if desired.
Serve: Transfer to individual bowls. Garnish with chopped spring onions.
notes: This dish is best served immediately.
Adjust mustard quantity to your preferred level of tanginess.

recipe_name: Mediterranean Braised Chicken with Root Vegetables
special_requests: European cuisine, non-alcohol, have a chicken fillet, don't have cabbage
visual_description: A single braised chicken fillet is centrally placed on a clean white porcelain dinner plate. Rustic large chunks of fork-tender potatoes and thick slices of vibrant orange carrots are artfully arranged around the chicken. The chicken and vegetables are generously coated in a rich, rustic red tomato and oregano sauce, with visible pieces of caramelized onion and minced garlic. The chicken boasts a golden-brown exterior from initial searing, contrasting with its tender interior. Vegetables retain their shape and bright color. A fresh sprig of oregano rests atop the chicken, with a slight drizzle of golden olive oil enhancing the sheen. The composition is balanced and inviting, with moderate negative space. The setting features a simple wooden table, a folded white cotton napkin beside the plate, and natural, even lighting from the side, creating a warm bistro ambiance.
cultural_serving_suggestions: Serve with crusty artisan bread to soak up the rich sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Season chicken fillets with salt and pepper. Sear chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove chicken from pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion to the pot. Sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and dried oregano. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and chicken broth. Add bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
Return chicken fillets to the pot. Add potato chunks and carrot slices around the chicken.
Cover the pot and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 75°C) and vegetables are fork-tender.
Remove bay leaf. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with a fresh oregano sprig.
notes: Ensure chicken is cooked through to an internal temperature of 75°C (167°F) for food safety.

visual_description: A rustic, comforting baked chicken and root vegetables. A single generous portion rests on a simple, round, off-white ceramic plate on a well-worn, warm-toned wooden dining table. Chicken chunks are nestled among roasted potato chunks, carrot rounds, and onion quarters. The chicken is golden-brown, with tender white meat. Potatoes are soft, browned at edges. Carrots are vibrant orange. Onions are caramelized. Roasted tomatoes create a rich sauce coating ingredients. Fresh, chopped parsley adds color. Warm kitchen light creates soft shadows. A simple glass of water and a casually folded cloth napkin complete the homely kitchen scene.
cultural_serving_suggestions: Serve directly from the baking dish onto individual plates.
Best served with crusty bread for dipping in the savory sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Wash and peel potatoes and carrots. Cut potatoes into 3 cm chunks. Cut carrots into 2 cm thick rounds.
Peel and quarter the onion. Peel and mince garlic cloves.
Pat chicken fillets dry. Cut each fillet into 2-3 large chunks.
In a large roasting dish, combine potato chunks, carrot rounds, onion quarters, minced garlic, diced tomatoes, dried oregano, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well to coat all vegetables.
Nestle chicken chunks among the vegetables. Pour chicken broth into the dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes.
Check chicken internal temperature. It should reach 75°C.
Remove from oven. Let rest 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.
